newsitem.title: USA: News Corp unit forms online distributor.
newsitem.headline: News Corp unit forms online distributor.

text.p: News Corp's Kesmai unit said on Tuesday that it had formed ARIES Online Games to publish and distribute computer games to online services and the Internet.
Kesmai said ARIES would offer games to commercial online services and Internet providers who have paying customers.

"Distribution relationships are already in place with America Online, CompuServe Corp, Concentric Network, Delphi, Genie and Prodigy Inc, along with Internet service providers such as EarthLink," it said.
ARIES is the second business unit under Kesmai, a holding company, it said.
The first one, Kesmai Studios, develops games for online services, it added.

Prodigy is owned by International Wireless, a privately-held Cambridge, Mass. company, one of whose major investors is Mexico's Grupo Carso SA. Delphi is owned by News Corp. Genie is owned by IDT Corp. Concentric Network Corp is private.
